title: Fullstack Web & Platform Engineer
description: Lead the technical design and development of scalable web-based applications, frontend UI architecture, and high-throughput Node.js microservices.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead technical design and development of soft-real-time web-based applications and enterprise platforms.

### Responsibilities
- Define application architecture, technology choices, coding standards, and development practices.
- Design scalable, secure frontend (React) and backend (Node.js) systems.
- Lead database modeling, API optimization, and security practices (auth, encryption, rate-limiting).
- Mentor junior developers and drive technical design reviews.

### Requirements
- Strong experience in Node.js, TypeScript, and React.
- 5+ years of software development experience across web applications and databases.
